purpose: Task capture ownership and actor/critical region provenance targets; compile-time and runtime proofs are NOT implemented across backends.

semanticRequirements.readonlyRecord: Treat a readonly record view as an alias until the compiler proves an independent immutable owned snapshot; field-wise Send is insufficient.
semanticRequirements.ownedStruct: Owned inline struct moves may be Send when every field is proven Send, there is no live alias, and the move is affine.
semanticRequirements.copyScalar: Copy-safe scalar may be snapshotted at Task submission without moving the parent.
semanticRequirements.independentTask: Independent Task launch is a one-shot owned/Copy transfer boundary; no actor self, active critical guard, stack loan, or foreign/scheduler authority.
semanticRequirements.scopedRead: Ordinary loans fail closed; a structured immutable READ exception needs Sync referent, exact place and allocation generation, lexical scope and physical child quiescence.
semanticRequirements.critical: Protect state/resource, guard held by logical task/continuation, thread carries execution only; no implicit await, blocking select/channel or scheduler-yield while guard is live.
semanticRequirements.actorSpawn: Spawned actor has new heap, stack/mailbox and generation; task/parent cannot transfer raw actor state loans, only owned/copy/authorized message data.
semanticRequirements.exit: Release linear guards exactly once along success, return, exception, panic/cancel cleanup; do not reclaim a borrowed allocation before physical retirement.
semanticRequirements.lowering: Fail closed before executable IR/object publication whenever compiler-rooted loan/region proof is absent.
